decision.rationale: The macOS boundary resolves PRR-020, but WeChat downstream recovery ignores dispatch and non-retryable evidence. A deterministic cross-package probe recorded one AXPress followed by a coordinate click and an outer success result, so PRR-021 blocks merge.

summary: The four-commit delta correctly makes direct action-timeout retryability dispatch-aware. Complete caller-path review found PRR-021: WeChat can execute another mutation after a dispatched or unknown Accessibility action outcome, violating the documented no-replay contract. The PR requires changes despite green broad tests and exact-head CI.

findings.title: WeChat replays an action after the backend reports a dispatched unknown outcome
findings.observation: The macOS layer returns requestDispatched=true and retryable=false after a written action loses its response, but WeChat fallback gates inspect only generic failure kind or collapse strategy failure and issue another mutation.
findings.trigger: A warm action worker receives an AXPress and the operation executes or may execute, but its response is lost, malformed, or replaced by EOF; a structured native action error after the native call is another unsafe case.
findings.impact: One semantic request can perform two desktop mutations. The second operation can use coordinates from a stale pre-action snapshot, activate a different control, and report success while hiding the unknown first outcome.

evidence.description: A write-attempted worker EOF or protocol failure is marked dispatched, propagated through transport, and mapped to a non-retryable accessibility_action_failed result.
WeChat unconditionally authorizes coordinate fallback for accessibility_action_failed and issues the second click.
Mapped navigation, search results, visible contacts, and search focus contain the same root recovery behavior through coordinate, Return, selector, or strategy continuation.

A safe synthetic worker recorded one AXPress and returned requestDispatched=true with both retryability fields false; the WeChat layer then executed click with stale coordinates and returned success. The invariant probe exited 21.
The generated native action worker invokes AXUIElementPerformAction or AXUIElementSetAttributeValue before a nonzero error is passed to generic fail(), which still emits actionAttempted=false.
Existing WeChat tests contain no requestDispatched coverage and explicitly expect generic action failure followed by click, encoding the unsafe behavior.

findings.remediation: Centralize a side-effect recovery predicate across every WeChat fallback and strategy continuation. Dispatched, attempted, non-retryable, or unknown outcomes must cause zero further mutation; only explicit pre-dispatch or unsupported evidence may authorize fallback. Correct actionAttempted reporting after the native API call.
findings.verification: Use real synthetic workers for dispatch-then-EOF, post-dispatch timeout, malformed response, and native action failure; assert one recorded action, fail-closed public guidance, and zero additional click, keypress, selector, or strategy mutation in every affected WeChat path while preserving explicitly safe fallback cases.

findings.title: A dispatched action timeout was incorrectly advertised as retryable
findings.observation: The prior warm action path lost the worker write boundary and mapped every action timeout to retryable protocol guidance. The current result preserves dispatch state and permits retry only when requestDispatched is exactly false.
findings.trigger: The caller deadline expires before the worker write or after the worker receives an action but before its response arrives.
findings.impact: Before remediation, a direct protocol consumer could retry an unknown mutating outcome and duplicate an already-executed UI action.

evidence.description: Worker results retain dispatch evidence, action transport propagates it, and protocol mapping fails closed for dispatched or unknown action timeouts.
Subprocess unknown, fake-worker unknown, real pre-dispatch, and real post-dispatch outcomes have dedicated assertions.
The full package passed and the real pre/post-dispatch pair passed ten consecutive iterations under strict ResourceWarning handling.
Exact-head GitHub CI passed all configured test, package, wheel, and distribution checks.

findings.remediation: Completed at the macOS protocol boundary: preserve dispatch evidence and fail closed for dispatched or unknown action timeouts. PRR-021 separately tracks downstream replay.
findings.verification: Completed for direct consumers: pre-dispatch, post-dispatch, unknown transport, non-action compatibility, package, root, release, and exact-head CI gates pass.

required_actions.action: Make every WeChat mutating fallback honor dispatch, attempt, and non-retryable evidence; correct post-native-call attempt reporting; add cross-package no-replay regressions for all affected paths.
Preserve action dispatch evidence and fail closed for dispatched or unknown direct action timeouts.

assumptions: Coordinate click, selector click, Return, and continued search or open strategy are retries of the same semantic side effect when invoked after an action failure.
Once a mutating worker request is written, response loss leaves the desktop outcome unknown even when protocol status is failed rather than timeout.
retryable=false, requestDispatched=true, and missing dispatch evidence require fail-closed behavior unless stronger explicit pre-dispatch evidence is available.
Green broad tests cannot override a deterministic counterexample when those tests currently assert the unsafe fallback sequence.
